archive.binding_source: Root stable archive observation and app-notary-retry1.json; no archive mutation or repeat source check by reviewer.

observed_failure: New Xcode notarytool 1.1.0 ARM execution terminated SIGBUS during upload. Crash frames include NSString formatting/String.init(format); this is an uploader failure, not an Apple rejection of submitted code.

proposal.scope: One bounded retry of the exact existing archive

assessment: No concrete blocker. Existing universal binary and successful Intel --version check establish executable availability. Changing uploader execution architecture and S3 endpoint preserves submitted app bytes and every trust gate. Effectiveness is unproven; no Apple-confirmed architecture workaround was found.
required_evidence: Exact command, tool version/architecture, archive hash and distinct log/receipt
Successful upload completion and exit before treating pending submission as uploaded
Apple Accepted status and log for exact submission, followed by app staple and validation
Preserve prior failed submissions and receipts

packaging_recovery.verified_behavior: --prepackaged skips doPack for normal mac targets and calls packageInDistributableFormat on the supplied app.
packaging_recovery.consequence: The app must already be signed, Accepted and stapled; prepackaged is not proof of these gates.
sequence: Verify accepted and stapled app; retain code-sign and staple evidence
Create DMG and ZIP from that exact app with existing generated release config and arm64 targets; no re-signing/source rebuild
Run existing packaged CLI and browser CLI checks from the interrupted canonical release sequence
Notarize the signed DMG, staple and validate it
Run existing refresh-notarized-update-metadata.cjs after DMG stapling
Create the stable alias from final DMG, then capture local artifact/feed/ZIP identity and root trust receipts
prohibited_shortcuts: No source rebuild required by these transport failures
No website installer download or local app activation

sources.supports: Apple DTS identifies the same SIGBUS/formatting crash across users and calls it environmentally triggered; no guaranteed fix offered.
Rosetta can execute Intel software on supported Apple silicon macOS; this does not establish a notarytool bug fix.
Canonical postpackaging CLI, DMG notarization, staple, refresh and alias obligations.
Regenerate DMG blockmap/feed digest after stapling.

remaining_release_gates: Successful upload, Apple acceptance, staples and final local artifact/publication proof remain pending; root owns execution.
reviewer_mutations: Only this evidence file; no app/source/tool/signing/provider mutations.
